state.background: The system preserves immutable exact versions. Aggregate state and each event must stay small; independent children are not stored as parent collections. Projection reads can lag. A read or admission that starts before access revocation may be in flight.

cases.citations: A section can cite arbitrarily many independently added source versions. Draft approval emits all current citations in one event.
cases.frozen_cut: Before approval, an authority rejects new edits for a draft, waits for all previously admitted edits to terminate, and supplies a complete immutable source cut. Approval binds that cut. Previously admitted edits cannot commit after the authority declares the cut complete.
cases.review_race: A change is assessed significant concurrently with period close. Its section-review reactor has not yet consumed that committed assessment. Close checks only the current section-review projection.
cases.handoff_race: A consultant reads handoff status open and selection present. The lead closes the handoff. The consultant then posts feedback without a fresh authoritative admission ordered against the close.
cases.reply: An immutable reply references a feedback identity and the author. The original feedback has its own separately controlled change-request resolution.
cases.review_author: A lead authored a prior draft revision, but a query of an eventually consistent authors projection misses that revision. The lead approves the draft as an independent reviewer.
cases.instant_access: An authorized download starts, the handoff closes, and bytes already delivered to the consultant cannot be recalled.

citation_parent.instructions: Can the size of the draft approval event in cases.citations grow with the number of citations?

frozen_cut.instructions: Does cases.frozen_cut prevent an edit admitted before freeze from appearing after the approved cut?

review_race.instructions: Can close in cases.review_race miss a review that must be created from an already committed assessment?

handoff_race.instructions: Can feedback in cases.handoff_race be accepted after the handoff has closed?

reply.instructions: Can cases.reply preserve the feedback's separate resolution without storing the reply on the feedback owner?

review_author.instructions: Can approval in cases.review_author violate the requirement that the reviewer authored no draft revision?

instant_access.instructions: Can closing the handoff in cases.instant_access retract bytes already delivered to the consultant?
